message: リ・クリエの夜に

name: Synn
message: 「It's over, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「I already... know that」
Azel slapped away the outstretched hand.

name: Azel
message: 「How you underestimate me. Does the victor intend to lend a hand out of pity?」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure are stubborn. That was just a fight. And I want to make up」

name: Azel
message: 「A battle with the fate of the world at stake. To dismiss it with such a vulgar word」

name: Azel
message: 「Is this the magnanimity of a Demon Lord? Or are you merely a fool?」

name: Synn
message: 「The latter, definitely. I didn't do all this just because I'm the Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「To you, who was ordered to regenerate the world, it might certainly seem foolish」

name: Synn
message: 「But that foolish thing is the very conviction we hold」

name: Azel
message: 「Tell me. Where does the wellspring of power that surpasses even my master's will come from?」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it that you people refuse to yield? That conviction--is it to protect the world?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Azel. There's something I want to show you」

name: Synn
message: 「This is the answer to your question. What I wanted to protect wasn't the world--」

name: Synn
message: 「It was the Holy Night Festival」

name: Azel
message: 「F-For something like this... I lost for this...」

name: Ria
message: 「You say that, Azel, but it's far more important than you think」

name: Ria
message: 「It's Ryuusei Academy's biggest event, filled with the wishes of so many people」

name: Ria
message: 「This year's Holy Night Festival will never come again」

name: Ria
message: 「That's why Synn, everyone on the Student Council, and the entire student body worked so hard to make it a wonderful memory」

name: Synn
message: 「All so we could live a sparkling school life together, right?」
This is my conviction. What I presented as my campaign promise.
Because I hadn't fulfilled this condition, I couldn't be satisfied with my idea of a 'sparkling school life.'

name: Lolotte
message: 「And while exterminating demons at the same time, mind you? Why, we were working so hard we barely had time to sleep」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone at the academy came together as one, working hard to make the Holy Night Festival a success!」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, I'd been hoping you could join us too, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「Unfortunately, that didn't happen. Still, I think we can enjoy it together starting now」

name: Azel
message: 「Absurd... Isn't a Demon Lord supposed to use the world as a shield? And yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「But there are people looking forward to the Holy Night Festival」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I couldn't lose. I knew I had to win no matter what」

name: Synn
message: 「If you join in too, Azel, I'm sure you'll understand how important it is」

name: Azel
message: 「Guh... ngh...」

name: Azel
message: 「Stay... away... from me...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Geez, you're testing my patience!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-What are you doing!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're completely powerless right now, Azel. Resisting is totally pointless!」

name: Azel
message: 「S-Stop it. Let go of me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, Amyrina's waiting too! Right this way~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, that settles that」

name: Misa
message: 「Now the real fun begins」

name: Ria
message: 「...Yeah. Everyone's already tired of waiting!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right! Let's go!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Welcome」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am deeply humbled by your kind invitation today」

name: Synn
message: 「Please take your time and enjoy yourself」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, come on, over here~~. Hurry, hurry!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eeeeeek!」

name: Azel
message: 「S-Stop it... ngh! Don't drag me!」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez! Where's the yummy stuff~!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Go on over to where Nanaka and Sacchin are」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, yummy food, wanna eat」

name: Sally
message: 「Even so, you can't eat Nanaka and Sacchin, 'kay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」

name: Pasta
message: 「Good grief, just how happy would I have been if I could spend time with Bylous-nyama-nya」

name: Synn
message: 「Pasta! You came!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I owe you one, nya. At the very least, I'll savor the feeling of spending time with Bylous-nyama-nya」
「Wait up, Pasta-cha~~n!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Who was that just now...?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Now then, let us enjoy new encounters and romance tonight as well」

name: Synn
message: 「Never learns, does he...」
The people from the shopping district also entered right behind them--

name: Helena
message: 「Congratulations, members of the Student Council!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Judging by how things look, it seems everything went smoothly. Thank you so much, truly」

name: Synn
message: 「We're the ones who should be thanking you! Thank you so much for sticking with us all this time」

name: Helena
message: 「So, where is Azel-chan...?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're looking for Azel, she's over there」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, come on, Azel-san, you're changing clothes too!!」

name: Azel
message: 「S-Stop it!! In an outfit like this-aaahhh!!」

name: Synn
message: 「And so it went」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, color me surprised~~」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's as if all the malice has drained out of her. Perhaps deep down, she was wishing for the exact same thing as Lolotte.」

name: Helena
message: 「The shooting stars are getting fewer and fewer, too.」

name: Melilot
message: 「So it's really over, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Our night is just getting started, though. Come on, you two, go have the time of your lives!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course we shall.」
Once all the participants have finished entering, the various events get underway.
Costume plays, and hospitality at the maid cafe.
And at last, the time for the dance party arrives.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria, would you do me the honor of dancing with me?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah♪」
And so, the final Holy Night Festival for the two of them begins.
Still, maybe because there are so many more girls here, there sure are a lot of same-sex couples.

name: Paqy
message: 「What is this, Private Lesbian Academy? Hehehe... It's straight out of a porno.」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How utterly shameless?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, that might not be half bad...\s04」

name: Shio
message: 「Sister, get a hold of yourself!! Here, dance with Sir Paqy!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaaah!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, let's dance together~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way, it's embarrassing!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'll take the guy's part for you~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Can you even lead?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot. Your feet are getting tangled.」

name: Melilot
message: 「T-This is... Well, what do you expect! It's my first time, after all...\s01」
Standing alone a short distance away, I found myself captivated by Ria-senpai and Misasagi-senpai dancing.
Leave it to two highborn ladies--their graceful movements are completely mesmerizing to watch.

name: Misasagi
message: 「You know... being by your side all this time has made me truly happy, Ria」

name: Ria
message: 「What's gotten into you, Akane? This isn't goodbye forever, you know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Maybe not, yeah. Still, I wish I could just keep dancing like this forever without thinking about a single thing」

name: Ria
message: 「Even after we graduate, we'll always be friends」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria... Thank you so much for giving me such a wonderful school life」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez! You're just trying to make me blush again so you can laugh at me, aren't you!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hehe... I'm a hopeless case, aren't I? Can't even get my honest feelings across」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm just kidding. I can tell everything just by looking at your face, Akane. I'm the one who should be thanking you」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh boy... Looks like you really got me there」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, I have to get the upper hand once in a while」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even if our paths diverge from here, I'll never forget the time the two of us spent together」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... Me neither... They're truly precious memories to me...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ahh... I wonder if time could just freeze right here like this...」

name: Ria
message: 「If that's what you wish for, Akane...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even so, it really wouldn't do if that actually happened」
The two of them stop dancing.

name: Ria
message: 「Akane...?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Your time with me is all over now」

name: Ria
message: 「We still have plenty of time left, don't we?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The person you really ought to be dancing with isn't me」
Misasagi-senpai slowly walks over toward me, bringing Ria-senpai along with her.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Thank you for everything up until now. I'm returning her to you」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The music is still playing, so go on, hurry up」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「This might be the last Holy Night Festival for us, sure, but it's the last one for you two as well. Gotta keep things fair, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Ria-senpai. Will you dance with me?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes, I'd love to ♪」
And so, seen off by Misasagi-senpai, we blended into the circle of dancers.
Even though I'd always been terrible at it until now, today I was able to dance naturally.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. You've gotten really good before I knew it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I practiced a little bit after last time, you know.」

name: Ria
message: 「Even though you might not have gotten to dance with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I can dance with you anytime, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「I like you, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Me too... I love you.」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez...! Don't go surprising your senpai like that, bad boy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Saying things like that is why people call you childish...」

name: Ria
message: 「I am not! Saying 'I love you'... th-that's... something like that...」

name: Ria
message: 「Saying 'I love you'...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, just saying 'I like you' wouldn't be any different from before... So...」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you... not like it?」

name: Ria
message: 「N... No. I'm really...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm super, super happy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, do you...」

name: Ria
message: 「...Yeah, I love you...\s04」
The music stops, and the two of them stand rooted to the spot.
And from the sky they look up at together--

name: Ria
message: 「The stars...!」

name: Synn
message: 「The stars... disappeared...?」
The Re-Crea had passed.
From that moment on, shooting stars vanished from Ryuusei Town.
Yet, the sparkling life the two of them weave together will keep shining brightly forevermore.
Yes.
Just like powdery snow dancing in the sky, bathed in light.
